_comment: What skippy-core publishes besides the portal (core/cd/cd.py publish_all; docs/no-github.md): each entry watches a repo in the trunk and, when its tip (or, for a tarball, the published folder's tree) changes, builds and uploads it as skippy-deployer. It replaces doom-loop's GitHub Actions dev-deploy and the games VM's fetch of sigma-ground from GitHub.
